question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **CIRCUMSPECT**
solution: The correct answer is: **Cautious**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"circumspect"** means being wary and unwilling to take risks; thinking carefully about possible risks before doing or saying something. (सावधान/सोच-समझकर) • **Example:** She was circumspect about revealing her personal information to strangers. • The word **"cautious"** means being careful to avoid potential problems or dangers. (सतर्क) • **Example:** He took a cautious approach to investing his money in the stock market. • Hence, "circumspect" and "cautious" share similar meanings, making "cautious" the most appropriate synonym. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cautious**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Reckless** (लापरवाह): Acting without thinking or caring about the consequences. • **Example:** Driving recklessly in heavy traffic can lead to serious accidents. • **Brash** (अत्यधिक आत्मविश्वासी और आक्रामक): Being self-assertive in a rude, noisy, or overconfident way. • **Example:** His brash attitude often annoyed his colleagues. • **Carefree** (बिना चिंता के): Free from worries or responsibilities. • **Example:** During their vacation, they enjoyed a carefree week on the beach. 36:T960, The correct answer is: **Menagerie**.
